## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-4 is misclassified: source-29 expressly claims to resolve Conjecture 4.10, directly proves the lower family, and treats the transposed family only in a remark. Calling the latter “still open” does not accurately record this mixed evidentiary status.
- claim-5 combines generator number and integral freeness. The asserted deduction of freeness from source-29 needs the degreewise indecomposable-quotient argument, including \(N=0\) and \(a=0\), or must be marked unresolved by the cited passages.
- The sweep omits the semantic open-method remark “We do not know how to use them for some alternate approach” at lines 934–937.
- Duplicate conjectural occurrences at lines 202–211 and 570–574 are not each given an unambiguous classification.
- Several required “excerpts” are only paraphrased. The certificate requires bounded exact text for every occurrence and for the invoked Theorem 4.8 formulas and hypotheses.

## Unresolved certificates
- [source-refresh] Revise the source-30 certificate to transcribe every bounded exact occurrence—including lines 934–937—classify each occurrence explicitly, and distinguish source-29’s express resolution claim, direct lower-family theorem, transposed-family remark, and any derived indecomposable-quotient consequences.
